description:
Look up Minz data, summarize your sales and work situation, suggest what to do first, and make confirmed changes, right inside ChatGPT.

Minz supports these workflows: work and calendar overview; company, contact, lead, opportunity and pipeline lookup; deal coaching from recently won deals; MinzSpend expenses and settlement/reimbursement reports; your pending approvals, requests and notifications; operations, company directory, omni inbox, OKR and document register lookups; and actions such as tasks, calendar events, OKR check-ins, deal follow and team chat messages.

Lookups only read data your Minz account is allowed to access. Anything that changes data in Minz is shown to you first and happens only after you confirm it, and only with the write permissions you granted. Answers are in your language (English by default, Vietnamese when you write in Vietnamese), separate facts from judgment, and state the period, scope and data limits. Expense and request approvals are not available and stay in Minz.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my work and calendar this week and point out what needs priority.
Review my current pipeline and suggest the deals that need attention.
Summarize my MinzSpend expenses and reports this month and flag the ones to review.
